question: 2 October 2019 marks the________________ birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**150th**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **2 October 2019** marks the **150th birth anniversary** of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi, also known as the "Father of the Nation," was born on **2 October 1869**.
 
• His birth anniversary is commemorated every year as **Gandhi Jayanti**, a national holiday in India.
 
• Gandhi's principles of **non-violence and truth** had a significant impact on India's independence movement and continue to inspire movements for civil rights and freedom across the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In 2007, the **United Nations General Assembly** declared **2 October** as the **International Day of Non-Violence**, acknowledging Gandhi's role in promoting peace and non-violence worldwide.
 
• Gandhi's philosophy and leadership played a crucial role in India's struggle for independence from British rule.
 
• He led nationwide campaigns for easing poverty, expanding women's rights, building religious and ethnic amity, ending untouchability, and achieving Swaraj or self-rule.
 
• His autobiography, "**The Story of My Experiments with Truth**," provides an insight into his life and principles.
